reviews_captured_by_me.text: Dennis has been lovely to work with, consulting on the phone, looking at samples in his shop and on site installing. Our shower walls were out of square, which was not caught in the measurement phase. There were also some high/ low spots in our sub floor and there was a minor defect in the casting of the shower pan. Dennis could have easily caulked it all in and I would have been none the wiser. Instead, he cast a new pan to fit, costing him a half days of time, a special trip to Durango and material. All of this was done at their cost. Majestic Marble is an ethical, fair, communicative outfit, I HIGHLY recommend. We ended up with a gorgeous shower surround for a fraction of the price of tile. Pics attached, it looks even better with the dust wiped off.

I was admiring the beautiful marble work at my house this morning, and contemplating the artistry that goes into the mixing and realized that I hadn’t fully appreciated it until now. These guys do fantastic work and I’m super grateful for them. Dennis is awesome! Thanks for creating my dream masterbath and so many other works of art that make my home look like I dreamt it would.
Dennis does beautiful work. He is reliable, friendly, and professional. He did one tub and one shower surround for us. Definitely would recommend!
